fields.name: id
fields.notes: stable primitive id, deterministic from source draw-event order

fields.name: primitive_type
fields.notes: curve = arc/circle/curve; excluded from linear distance math (DD-3)

fields.name: coords
fields.notes: vertices / endpoints in source evidence frame (mm-scale); curve keeps raw params instead

fields.name: net_island
fields.notes: connected-copper-island id (geometric, NOT logical net name — logical role is design-ir plan scope)

fields.name: curve_params
fields.notes: raw arc/circle params when primitive_type=curve; None otherwise

fields.name: distance_mm
fields.notes: computed distance; None only inside an error result (see error field)

fields.name: covered
fields.notes: plane_coverage verdict; None for distance queries

fields.name: provenance
fields.notes: DD-5: geometry source trace aligned with ValidationEvidence source_anchor/threshold_provenance

fields.name: error
fields.notes: populated instead of a value on fail-fast (DD-4); mutually exclusive with distance_mm/covered

fields.name: source_layers
fields.notes: copper layers whose primitives fed the computation

fields.name: skipped_curves
fields.notes: curve primitive ids excluded (DD-3) so caller knows coverage is incomplete

fields.name: algorithm
fields.notes: e.g. segment_min_distance | ray_casting; deterministic method label

fields.name: missing_items
fields.notes: explicit list of what was absent; caller must judge unverifiable, never pass
